issue.title: Typing a UTable column as a relation breaks the filter types
issue.body:
### Environment

- @acme/ui: 1.4.0
- TypeScript: 5.9.2

### Description

When a column of `UTable` is typed as a relation to another row type, the `filters` prop no longer type checks. Passing `{ parent: { slug: { $null: true } } }` gives `Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'slug' does not exist in type 'ColumnFilter<undefined>'`. The filter works at runtime, only the types reject it. Wrapping it in `{ data: { slug } }` makes the error go away but then the filter does nothing.

Is there a way to write my row type so this works?
issue.author: typedtom
